title: server name validation rejects underscores
body:
### Description

Since 0.33, underscores in server names are rejected with this error message:

```
 File "/nix/store/sq2000srz6b5cgs9gvrsk1c84y4l5y78-matrix-synapse-0.33.0/lib/python2.7/site-packages/synapse/config/_base.py", line 331, in load_or_generate_config
    generate_keys=generate_keys,
  File "/nix/store/sq2000srz6b5cgs9gvrsk1c84y4l5y78-matrix-synapse-0.33.0/lib/python2.7/site-packages/synapse/config/_base.py", line 360, in read_config_files
    is_generating_file=False,
  File "/nix/store/sq2000srz6b5cgs9gvrsk1c84y4l5y78-matrix-synapse-0.33.0/lib/python2.7/site-packages/synapse/config/_base.py", line 172, in generate_config
    report_stats=report_stats,
  File "/nix/store/sq2000srz6b5cgs9gvrsk1c84y4l5y78-matrix-synapse-0.33.0/lib/python2.7/site-packages/synapse/config/_base.py", line 155, in invoke_all
    results.append(getattr(cls, name)(self, *args, **kargs))
  File "/nix/store/sq2000srz6b5cgs9gvrsk1c84y4l5y78-matrix-synapse-0.33.0/lib/python2.7/site-packages/synapse/config/server.py", line 173, in default_config
    _, bind_port = parse_and_validate_server_name(server_name)
  File "/nix/store/sq2000srz6b5cgs9gvrsk1c84y4l5y78-matrix-synapse-0.33.0/lib/python2.7/site-packages/synapse/http/endpoint.py", line 100, in parse_and_validate_server_name
    server_name,
ValueError: Server name 'server_sqlite' contains invalid characters

```

Looks like the relevant change is 546bc9e28b3d7758c732df8e120639d58d455164 


### Steps to reproduce

Use an underscore in a server name and observe the error.

Expected result: underscores in server names should be accepted.

### Version information

- **Homeserver**:  own test server
- **Version**:        0.33.0
- **Install method**:  nix
- **Platform**:    NixOS
